- Down 29% over 30 min, 40% off the high, yet 15-min return +63% with sell/buy ratio ~1.07 on the first two minutes. Volume is churning, not clearly accumulating.
- Launch bot present and 41.6% bundle share: the high-variance profile that has historically lost money.

memos.scout:
Honest case for buying dogwifcap now: limited, and it rests on a few readings.

- Organic class, no airdrop dump, and the top-3 holder share (7.4%) and top-5 buyer share at launch (14.5%) are not concentrated.
- Last 15 minutes show net buy flow of +19.3 SOL on $40k volume, with 366 buyers against 301 sellers, and a +62.6% return over that window.
- Post-graduation buying (179.5 SOL from 365 buyers) outweighed selling early, with a 1.07 sell-to-buy ratio.
- Pool depth of 70 SOL is reasonable for a $20 ticket.

Against this: the coin is 40% off its 30-minute high and down 29% over 30 minutes, the 15-minute rebound was recent and sellers are still numerous, and 41.6% of the curve is bundled, which is a meaningful insider-coordination signal. A launch bot was present. Buying into a fading bounce is the pattern that usually loses.

My read: the demand case is thin and the bundle share is a real warning. I'd recommend skipping unless the desk has a reason to believe the bundle is not coordinated selling pressure.
memos.skeptic: Most likely loss path: a bundled-launch dump on a coin whose "ORGANIC" label hides insider exit. Bundle share is 41.6% of the curve, and the launch bot was present with a sell-to-buy ratio of 1.07 in the first two minutes, so early supply was already being resold. The 30-minute high has already fallen 40%, and the 30-minute return is -29%, so this is a fading coin, not a fresh breakout. The last 15 minutes show a +63% return, but net flow was only +19 SOL against 156 SOL sold, and 301 sellers versus 366 buyers means the bounce is thin. Pool depth of 70 SOL means a $20 round trip costs roughly 3-5%, so any bounce under that is lost to fees. Name "dogwifcap" riding the dogwifhat meme is a copy pattern, not evidence. Verdict: skip.
